device_entry.name: 英特尔 RealSense D435 深度相机
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 一款面向机器人与机器视觉实验的 RGB-D 深度相机，可采集彩色图像并支持空间感知。该设备常用于目标观察、场景记录、视觉算法测试和实验过程的实时视频采集；从当前证据看，此处主要使用其 RGB 视频输出能力。
device_entry.description_en: An RGB-D depth camera for robotics and machine vision experiments, capable of capturing color images and supporting spatial perception. It is commonly used for target observation, scene recording, vision algorithm testing, and live video capture during experiments; based on the available evidence, the RGB video output is the primary function used here.
